faqs.q: Services How long does a typical project take to complete?
faqs.a: Timelines depend on scope and complexity. A small project usually takes 2 to 4 weeks, while a larger custom solution can take 8 to 12 weeks.

faqs.q: What is the process once I book a free demo?
faqs.a: After you book a demo, our team reviews your requirements, walks you through a live demonstration, and then shares a clear proposal with scope, timeline, and cost.

faqs.q: Will I get regular updates during development?
faqs.a: Yes. We follow an agile workflow with weekly progress updates and a dedicated point of contact.

faqs.q: Do you provide support after the project is delivered?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer post-launch support and maintenance plans including bug fixes, updates, and performance monitoring.
